name: J and L Pickin' Patch
tagline: J & L Pickin' Patch — Northeast Indiana Local Food Network
description: In Fort Wayne, IN, J and L Pickin' Patch raises Pumpkins and Flowers on a working farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
